QuestInfo.name: Just For You 2
QuestInfo.0: Silver congratulated you for passing the test and has something else to say. Talk to him.
QuestInfo.1: He says the town foxes prepared another special gift to mark your passage into foxdom. You got chills when he said they put a lot of effort into it. Go back to your house.
QuestInfo.2: You got a pair of fox ears and a fox tail, presumably to help you fit in better. You tried them on in a moment of weakness, but sure enough you look ridiculous.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\r\n#fUI/UIWindow2.img/QuestIcon/8/0# 3000\r\nCan proceed with Raining On My Parade

0.0: It feels like only yesterday you came to this town, and... Wait, was it yesterday? I don't remember. Anyway, now you're an official fox! I'm very proud of you. You should be proud of you too.
0.1: Oh, and I hear our people prepared another gift to mark your achievement. They put a lot of time and effort into it, and it is quite astounding!
0.2: I know that you will love it too. It's at your house, so hurry on home.

0.msg: A gift from the foxes... That can't be good. The harder they worked, the worse I'm going to feel about this...

no.0: Are you worried about the return gifting thing? Don't worry, the gift for becoming a full fox doesn't count. We're creatures of reason, after all.

default.0: The gift is in your house. You'll love it!
